summary_zh: 官方 .73 原生 CUDA 开启首轮在播放中第二次拖动平滑度时崩溃一次；关闭组24次拖动及开启复验12次播放中拖动均完成。崩溃转储直接指向 Resolve 滑块事件处理链的空指针读异常，尚未确认 CUDA 参数槽等待、失败回退或 CUDA 本身为根因。

crash_analysis.secondary_context: Qt mouse dispatch is nested above a timer/processEvents path. This is evidence of event handling context, not proof of an object lifetime/reentry bug.
crash_analysis.slot_wait: Not confirmed. No named cuEventSynchronize, cuStreamSynchronize, or cuCtxSynchronize frames in the captured ~* k 24 stacks. No stack contains both the plugin and nvcuda modules. A crash-time snapshot cannot exclude an earlier transient wait.
crash_analysis.plugin_waits: 17 plugin-containing thread stacks include WaitOnAddress. Without exact private symbols and a lock ownership graph, these waits do not establish deadlock or identify Slot::prepare.
crash_analysis.fallback: No native CUDA failure/fallback/error log before the crash; backend remained cuda through 16:09:30 UTC. OFF backend=wgpu was explicitly selected, not evidence of failure fallback.
crash_analysis.post_crash_warning: Timeout waiting for interop lookahead first appears at local 00:09:32.499, after the fatal dump timestamp. It is not evidence of the initial trigger.
crash_analysis.symbol_limits: No matching private PDB. Large-offset nearest export names such as boost codecvt, license client, plugin capabilities and cuProfilerStop must not be interpreted as exact private functions.

related_modules.role: smoothness recompute before native rendering; stabilization write lock at 2712; native fallback wait at 2720
Slot::prepare reuse wait; uninstrumented in the official .73 binary
Slot::free and stream/cache resource cleanup waits; remain static risks, not observed crash location

shared_warning.text: fuscript query exceeded 5000ms and was killed
shared_warning.interpretation: Occurs in both healthy comparison runs too. It is a scripting-helper timeout, not a parameter-slot completion/fallback log; not established as this crash root cause.

limitations: Only one crash; ON followup did not reproduce. No causal proof or reproducibility rate can be assigned to native CUDA from these three runs.
Different host version, Windows version, GPU/driver and media from the feedback environment (feedback: Resolve 21.1, Win10, RTX5060Ti).
Same source DRP imported into separate fresh projects; drag positions and values approximately matched, but one-pixel UI quantization and playback timing differ.
Drags were performed one at a time with UI readback and variable gaps. This is not a uniform high-frequency stress test or a performance benchmark.
Input injection drag_ms and CPU-side gpu_ms log values do not measure GPU completion latency.

No hang-time dump before the fatal exception, no per-slot entry/exit timing or lock ownership tracing, and no exact .73 private symbols; a CUDA wait or fallback cannot be conclusively classified from this evidence.

next_actions_ranked.action: Use matching .73 private symbols and a compatible x64 debugger to resolve plugin WaitOnAddress callers and trace the parameter callback around the observed Resolve slider crash; capture first-chance exception context.
next_actions_ranked.purpose: Turn the confirmed crash into exact callback/lifetime evidence without product source changes.

next_actions_ranked.action: Run a bounded matched rapid-drag sequence in ON/OFF with identical frame/parameter timing; if an actual hang appears, capture all-thread dumps during the hang before process exit.
next_actions_ranked.purpose: Distinguish an intermittent UI callback crash from persistent GPU/lock waits.

next_actions_ranked.action: If binary debugging is insufficient, propose a separate diagnostic build with slot/stream/fallback entry-exit tracing and thread/context identity; do not change wait or cleanup policy until evidence identifies the blocking path.
next_actions_ranked.purpose: Resolve missing slot/fallback observability; requires a later explicitly scoped code change.
